1.Name: Art of Conquest
1.Description: Everyone knows that the Empire's Imperial Military Barracks are well-known for turning average citizens into well-disciplined, resolute soldiers. The military established "Battle Trials" to test the knowledge that these soldiers carry, to determine whether or not they can use this knowledge to overcome their enemies. The Battle Trials encompasses many realistic challenges that soldiers may actually encounter while roaming Esperia. The adversaries within the trial aren't your average foes, they possess the power of the arcane, and there are many magically imbued War Relics to be found within the trial. The foes within the trial are abnormally strong, and in most cases cannot be fought head on. Only by using patience, opportunity and wit, can they be bested. With the proper utilization of War Relics, the weak can overcome the strong and clench victory from the jaws of defeat. This is the Art of Conquest.

2.Name: Ancient Seal
2.Description:
In those days of malevolence, three brave men - a swordsman, a mage and a craftsman - fought to defend their home. Employing their exceptional skill and wisdom, they crushed the demon's minions, pursuing them all the way to the cavern hideout, planning of destroying the demon that threatened their home. After the battle, the demon fell into a deep slumber, the exhausted warriors, unable to finish it off were left with no choice but to seal it away. In order to end the threat once and for all, the mage and craftsman transformed the cave where the demon rests and established a rigorous trial. They hoped that in the future, brave individuals of considerable talent and power would be able to totally eradicate the demon scourge.
Centuries later, the exploits of those three brave men have descended into rumor, a jumble of truth and fiction falling from the mouths of drunkards. Little do they know, the demon is about to stir...

3.Name: Peculiar Flowers
3.Description: "I hear that your goldflares can produce a miraculous restorative medicine that has made you extremely rich." The detective inquired but was only greeted with one of Lady Lina's enigmatic smiles as she sipped her tea. Years passed, and an urgent missive arrived from Lady Lina's daughter, Miss Lotti, asking the detective for aid in her mother's disappearance. And so, Detective returns to Goldflare Manor, where veiled mysteries lie in wait.

4.Name: The Painter's Spell
4.Description: In Esperia, there is no place that captivates painters more than the Dark Forest. A magician-artist has set up a studio on the edge of the woods, where he has created countless exquisite and enchanted paintings. Today, Pippa smelled the magic of the artworks and, together with her friend Nemora, followed the scent to his studio. Mesmerized by the magic, she could not resist touching one of the paintings, which triggered a powerful force that sucked both of them into it...

5.Name: The Sealing Sword
5.Description: From a remote corner of the land, a long-forgotten town sends a plea for help, claiming that nearby Hypogeans are stirring, about to break through the town's defenses. The Lightbearer Empire intends to send troops to suppress the scourge, but the rugged mountain roads are hindering the army's advance. In desperation, the Empire issued a commission to bounty hunters, calling for heroes to wipeout the Hypogeans and save the town from ruin. The long-neglected town welcomed new visitors. Stepping into the town, they realized that the situation here is far more complex than the request for help had implied...

6.Name: The Forgotten Frontier
6.Description:
Historical records cite that the Lightbearer Empire paid a hefty price in order to keep the undead out of the Black Woods.
        But there are no unbreakable walls - not on borders, nor in people's temples of faith.
        In the cold winds of the forest, the seeds of death have quietly fallen to the ground, taking root and sprouting into an evil unmatched. The decaying soil is stained an acidic green, its noxiousness so vile that no mortal can pass over it. 
    These Spectral Wastes block passage through to many places, and must be avoided at all costs.
    All horrors leave scars on the land.

7.Name: The Frozen Forbidden Land
7.Description: Now a seemingly peaceful and wintry land, this is where the dwarves deployed their fortifications during the Hypogean War a thousand years ago to protect a secret in the depths of this forest. The buildings have been weathered and destroyed over the past millennium, and so has the secret of legend. At this time, the wandering Mishka accidently enters the depths of the forest and meets Pippa who has been walking around in circles. Will the two lost girls find the "treasures" left behind by the dwarves?

8.Name: Sage's Rite
8.Description: Pippa's done it again! Another day of practicing new spells in a busy forest has led to another disastrous magical accident which put everyone in danger. Time for an intervention! Gramp Arden has brought Pippa to a special section of the forest to teach her a thing or two about thinking before you cast. Pippa should be OK as long as she can handle some constructive feedback.
8.UnlockTips: Complete 60% of The Frozen Forbidden Land

9.Name: Fields Of Stone
9.Description: The Dwarves have long been refugees, forced into a nomadic lifestyle and wandering the land since the loss of their ancestral homes. For decades they have slept in caves, beneath trees and bushes, anything that would afford a bit of shelter. In the desert areas known as the Fields Of Stone, most traces of the Dwarven civilization have been erased. All that remains are semi-operational pieces of scattered technology. Devices once used to protect the Dwarven lands now pose a serious threat to wanderers who enter the area. However, one old dwarf returns here year after year to scavenge. One never knows what kind of valuables one can pick up if they just concede to a little danger...

10.Name: The Forgotten Mine
10.Description:
In order to exploit the rich mineral deposits buried in this continent, the pioneering dwarves dug deep, winding underground mines, in which they constructed railroad tracks in all directions. As the minerals began to dwindle, the area became increasingly desolate, with many of the dwarves choosing to find work elsewhere.
 
    Magical turrets were also built by pioneering dwarves to fend off the hostile natives that tried to disrupt their mining efforts. The turrets use fire for ammunition and are one of the many technological masterpieces the dwarves have created. However, after the mine was abandoned and forgotten about, most of the turrets are now inactive and need to be reactivated.

1003.Name: The Depths of Time
1003.Description:
Our history books tell us one tale, but our memories may tell us otherwise. It's greatly believed that time is a linear constant, flowing in a single direction and taking us through a course of events that transpire around us. But a certain few know that this is far from the truth.
 A village once situated on this land was razed over a century ago, with the help of an ancient entity, you must traverse the time continuum and decide the village's. Difficult decisions must be made, do you save it and change the course of history? Or do you let it burn to the ground and allow for unforeseen circumstances to occur? Only you may decide, adventurer.

102.Name: The Lucent Vault
102.Description: Yet another peculiar realm, not too unlike 'The Divine Realm', this place is not bound by the normal laws of nature that govern Esperia. In an environment as unstable as it is, one must tread carefully, as to avoid the oddly-lit sky bridges collapsing without a moment's notice. No sane person would venture into such a hostile environment, but to those that seek only to enrich themselves, death is nothing more than a mere afterthought.

104.Name: The Fabled Forest
104.Description:
A once lush, green forest turned into nothing more than a decaying, lifeless plane, the fabled forest was a place difficult to find for those out of touch with the natural world, but for those that could find were vast treasures that awaited them.
 
    Now nothing more than a decaying husk, broken and crumbling under its own weight, there is little here in the dead forest to entice outsiders. Only the foolish and deranged are stupid enough to venture here, all with the hopes of finding a forgotten remnant of the fabled treasures which were once often spoken of.

105.Name: Fallen Souls
105.Description: The land between the empire of men and the undead, nothing more than an abandoned waste, home only to the fallen souls. Horror's Eve looms closer and with it, so do the terrors that lurk in the darkness. This is no place for anyone, much less two foolish girls...

106.Name: Highburn Stronghold
106.Description:
Another day, another battle. The constant struggle for supremacy between the Lightbearer Empire and the Mauler tribes rages on. Commander Estrilda Rayne of the royal army was tasked with the arduous mission of holding back the vicious, marauding tribes that constantly threatened to encroach upon Lightbearer lands. Day after Estrilda struggled to repel the relentless Maulers with little hope of respite in sight. The Maulers continued to pressure Highburn Stronghold with the hopes of finally making a breakthrough, but with the appearance of the feared warrior, Commander Hogan, this goal was proving to be more difficult than they'd envisioned.
With both sides distracted and locked in a stalemate, neither side paid much attention to anything else but the other, and with this an opportunity for conniving thieves arose. The Lightbearer stronghold and Mauler encampments hide not only gold, but also precious military supplies. The question that remains unanswered is, who will claim them?

108.Name: The Frosted Expanse
108.Description:
Winter comes and with it so does the Frozen Mother's embrace. The lush green fields of Esperia give way to the snowy blankets that she gifts to us.
    Rows of snow-covered pine trees sit silently beside their protectors, the snowmen of midwinter, waiting patiently to greet the midwinter travelers on their way through the valley.
    Yet not all is well in the frosted expanse, as a malicious creature lurks in the shadows, plotting to turn serenity into chaos, its true intentions still unknown.

109.Name: The Frozen Pass
109.Description: Snow falls while the wind works to slice its way through the bones of any wanderers which have chosen to traverse this treacherous terrain. The winding path works its way up and down the mountain sides, giving no chance for respite. The end of the year is upon us, and for some, the road home is a challenging one. These two brothers have a long and arduous road ahead of them, however, the wintry weather may be the least of their concerns.

110.Name: Frozen Ground
110.Description: What used to be a land teeming with life has been frozen white by the rapacious frost of the ice elementals. Arden managed to defeat them some years ago to usher in four seasons of equally wonderful weather. I just don't know how the bound elementals escaped. The starving wildlife has abandoned this area. Now snow is about to blanket everything once again.

111.Name: Trembling Highlands
111.Description: The trembling highlands, a cold and gloomy landscape that despite its elevated altitude gets very little sunlight. Shrill cries of birds sound from among the stunted copses of woodland, as if warning off any who have somehow found themselves here. The rare travelers passing through this region often speak of rumors of an old castle tucked away in some forgotten corner of the frosty murk. The nobles who once made their lives in its halls were supposedly cursed by a witch, and now all remains of the castle is a brooding, hollow shell beaten and weathered by the elements for years.

113.Name: The Forest's Edge
113.Description: Just as a squirrel buries its food, so do the dwarves stash their treasures. Located at the edge of the forest seems to be what looks like the remnants of an old dwarven mine. Scattered throughout the area, are small, winding paths that may hide hidden dangers... or perhaps treasures. Only the brave or foolish will know for sure.

112.Name: The Howling Wastes
112.Description: Situated far from civilization and home to only outlaws and vagabonds, the Howling Wastes offers little comfort to those that reside there. A lonely place, where the only sounds to be heard are the howls of the desert wind itself. The great vastness of this inhospitable desert is peppered with the odd canyon here and there. Yet, one of these canyons is not like the others. It stands out from the rest. An array of high energy defensive towers seem to be guarding something within one of this secluded canyon, and there's only one way to uncover its secrets. As the old adage goes: "Nothing ventured, nothing gained."

114.Name: The Frozen Hinterland
114.Description: A place of perpetual coldness, where only the sound of snowfall can be heard. Legend has it, that the snowy highland terrain can change in an instant whenever the snow ceases to fall, laying bear the true lay of the land for all to witness. One wonders, what will be seen this time?

115.Name: The Hazy Timberland
115.Description: Many folk have gotten lost within these hazy woods. Enshrouded by a mist that refuses to disperse, wanderers are often left to roam until they wander into an early grave. The thick mist has been said to hide great riches, left behind by the wanderers that weren't fortunate enough to escape the woods' hazy grasp. One must stay vigilant in such a confusing and peculiar landscape. One lapse in concentration and a traveler could become lost forever.

118.Name: The Depths of Time 2
118.Description: Within this region lies a town called Evercrest. Its inhabitants possess a unique skill to talk with the dead, a rare and unusual skill. These folk have branded as heretics by the Temple of Light, thus the temple clerics ordered the town to be cleansed. Years later, the town's story has still yet to be concluded, as demonic invaders march toward the township.

116.Name: The Echoing Valley
116.Description: The Echoing Valley, a place full of winding roads and few trees. Not much is able to live in this region. Tales speak of an ancient battle occurring on this very land, a battle which gave the region its namesake. Due to the very nature of the rock formations here, artillery and explosions would echo throughout the valley for an extraordinarily long time, causing the terrifying sounds of war to haunt the men that fought here long after the battle had ended. Some say even today, the echoes of war can still be heard reverberating around the Echoing Valley.

125.Name: Track of the Sands
125.Description: The Track of the Sands, also known as the Quarry Rail, was originally developed to transport rare minerals out of nearby mines. It is operated by the Imperial Freight Company, owned by the richest man in the empire, Reginald Gilder. After decades of operation, the Track of the Sands has become an increasingly important overland freight rout,.transporting vast quantities of industrial and military supplies every year. However, perhaps because the track is known to be owned by a very rich man, many more remote spots on the track are targeted for ambush by raiders hoping to steal the goods and ransom the train staff.

901.Name: Misty Valley
901.Description:
Due to the unusual tides in this region, few have actually seen the Misty Valley with their own eyes. For the valley only surfaces when the sea recedes. As a result of the strange magnetic interference from the world's poles, the tide acts in an erratic manner, leaving those that wish to explore the valley a very short window of time to do so.
The buccaneers of the high seas, knowing of the obscurity that the erratic tides and misty clouds could provide, decided that this would be a prime location to store their ill-gotten gains, as in their minds, only those with a death wish would dare venture into such a treacherous region.

122.Name: Windfall Gorge
122.Description:
North of the desert is Windfall Gorge, a perilous place believed to be entirely unreachable.
 Storms twist and swirl atop the towering peaks of the surrounding cliffs. Even the most experienced desert guides struggle to find a route into the Gorge, so it's no surprise that even the most willful would-be wanderer will find themselves at a total loss...

2001.Name: Arena of Trials
2001.Description: The Arena of Trials is a place brimming with magical energy. In some ways, it doesn't truly exist in the real world. It's more like a fantastical mirage born of magic. Yet the dangers within this mirage are all too real. With trial upon trial and ordeal after ordeal, those who have successfully obtained the treasure are a precious few indeed!

120.Name: Black Woods
120.Description:
The Black Woods are located at the edge of the Lightbearer Empire. Since the Graveborn gained a foothold in the wastelands of the old kingdom of Bantus, they have been able to equal the Lightbearer's strength. King Thoran ordered his subjects to initiate a series of probing attacks against the Lightbearers, and the Black Woods was an ideal location to undertake such attacks.
       The Lightbearer frontier forces stationed within the Black Woods were no match for the Graveborn's numbers. Again and again, Lightbearer forces were pushed back, forced to retreat. The Lightbearers had no choice but to rely on the conscripted soldiers of nearby villages while they waited for the Divine Temple's righteous warriors, the Temple clerics to arrive. The Graveborn, fearing nothing more than the Divine Light were gradually pushed back and subdued once the Temple clerics had arrived. Now only the remnants of this bygone era remain.

123.Name: The Sandy Tracks
123.Description: As a region of great significance and vast resources, the Sandy Tracks is greatly valued by the Lightbearer high command. The mines spread throughout this region provide precious metals that the Lightbearer regiments so dearly require. After the dwarves were welcomed into the Lightbearer alliance, they swiftly constructed mines and rail tracks, many of which are protected by their ingeniously crafted Safety Gates and Checkpoints. Used for decades, the Safety Gates have prevented many would-be plunderers from stealing the king's resources land.

121.Name: Mirael's Nightmare
121.Description: The Burning Light, also known as Mirael is regarded as one of the deadliest bounty hunters in the realm. Her temperament is just as fiery as her bright red hair. Her fiery magic is sometimes too powerful for even herself to keep under control. Yet, in comparison to her youth, it could be say that Mirael has made leaps and bounds when it came to controlling her temper and powers. As a student, Mirael would often cause her teachers at the Astral Academy headaches with her wanton destruction of school property. In order to control her, the teachers would have to occasionally send to "Detention" rooms, where her powers would be somewhat constrained. As far as Mirael was concerned, she might as well have been in a living nightmare, without her power, she felt empty. This nightmare was one she wished she'd never have to experience again.

124.Name: The Dusty Barrens
124.Description:
The Dusty Barrens, although on the surface is a sparse and hostile environment, hides many precious and vital resources. Privy to this knowledge, the dwarves would harvest the land's precious resources to provide arms for the King's Army.
However, as a barren desert, moving such massive amounts of mineral ore would not be an easy task, thus, the dwarves created their own highly efficient rail system. Traversing such a hostile land would not be easy, but luckily enough, this is what the dwarves do best.

126.Name: Cinder Grottoes
126.Description:
The Cinder Grottoes are on the site of an ancient palace.
       After the merciless magic bombings of several hundred years of The Cinder War, the earth was torn asunder and the palace collapsed into ruins. The enduring war had an overwhelmingly negative impact on humanity, and many of their greatest achievements and finest architecture were destroyed - the history books and ancient records gone with them.
       Although the Cinder Grottoes are dilapidated, it's rumored they still hide many ancient magic tomes. Doubtless, the Esperian Order of the Sun were lured here by such rare knowledge.
       In order to find the lost magic of the Cinder Grottoes, the Order of the Sun send a number of their mages to search the place. Unfortunately, only one of them survived. After hearing from the survivor of a terrible monster waiting inside, the Lightbearer temple sent in a team to exorcise the lurking creature. In the dark depths, the two forces must both act cautiously in the face of unseen dangers.

130.Description:
The Realm of Denial is a special space between Esperia and the realms of the dead. Spirits still clinging onto the world, unwilling to die yet unable to be revived, gather here in hopes of breaking through into the world of the living. The memories of these lost wandering souls have been long since engulfed in the tides of time - they know not who they are or where they are from, existing and acting only on obsession, lingering eternally in the Realm of Denial.
Every year, a small opening forms in the Realm of Denial, giving lost souls the opportunity to visit the place that peaks their obsessions. The children of Esperia, meanwhile, spend the day dressing up as ghosts, going from door to door to ask for candy.
On this night, the Celestial Twins of Esperia, Lailah and Elijah, come to the Realm of Denial in order to guide lost spirits towards completing their unfinished business.

3002.Name: Fields Of Stone
3002.Description:
Our history books tell us one tale, but our memories may tell us otherwise. It's greatly believed that time is a linear constant, flowing in a single direction and taking us through a course of events that transpire around us. But a certain few know that this is far from the truth.
 A village once situated on this land was razed over a century ago, with the help of an ancient entity, you must traverse the time continuum and decide the village's. Difficult decisions must be made, do you save it and change the course of history? Or do you let it burn to the ground and allow for unforeseen circumstances to occur? Only you may decide, adventurer.
3002.UnlockTips: Complete 100% of "Fields Of Stone" within the Wandering Balloon.

127.Name: Deathly Marshlands
127.Description:
It was nearly a thousand years ago that a great battle erupted on this ancient battleground, a place where thousands of nameless souls found their final resting place. 
       Once a lush forest, the elements were not kind to this land. Now, all that remains is an unending marshland that spans as far as the eye can see. Pungent smells and gases assail the nostrils and obscure one's sight. The bubbling viscous undergrowth clings to any would-be adventurers, as if it were alive, refusing to relinquish its grasp on them.
       Although beset with its danger, the marsh does little to discourage the reckless and foolhardy adventurers that traverse it. Being the only way to the southern island, they have no choice but to accept the risk. Could the treasures hidden on the island be worth dying for?

3003.Name: Highburn Stronghold
3003.Description:
Another day, another battle. The constant struggle for supremacy between the Lightbearer Empire and the Mauler tribes rages on. Commander Estrilda Rayne of the royal army was tasked with the arduous mission of holding back the vicious, marauding tribes that constantly threatened to encroach upon Lightbearer lands. Day after Estrilda struggled to repel the relentless Maulers with little hope of respite in sight. The Maulers continued to pressure Highburn Stronghold with the hopes of finally making a breakthrough, but with the appearance of the feared warrior, Commander Hogan, this goal was proving to be more difficult than they'd envisioned.
With both sides distracted and locked in a stalemate, neither side paid much attention to anything else but the other, and with this an opportunity for conniving thieves arose. The Lightbearer stronghold and Mauler encampments hide not only gold, but also precious military supplies. The question that remains unanswered is, who will claim them?
3003.UnlockTips: Complete 100% of "Highburn Stronghold" within the Wandering Balloon.

131.Name: Bridge of Souls
131.Description:
There is no group of people throughout the whole of Esperia like the dwarfs. The dwarfs are the hardiest folk to have ever graced of Esperia. Their townships lay in waste, their castles crumbled and their lands smoldered. Such a terrible fate, brought upon them by malevolent, demonic invaders, yet not once did the dwarfs' resolve dwindle. No man or demon shall ever subjugate a dwarf. Never. The world has not been kind to the dwarves, but they march on, ever resolute.
Today was the day that Morvus, The Far Stalker, would bring the ashes of his fallen brethren to the Bridge of Souls, the only path to every dwarven warrior's final resting place, a place where they enter their eternal slumber. Morvus must raise the Bridge of Souls to gain passage to the dwarfs' sacred burial grounds. Anything less would be a dishonor to his fallen brethren.

3004.Name: The Howling Wastes
3004.Description: Situated far from civilization and home to only outlaws and vagabonds, the Howling Wastes offers little comfort to those that reside there. A lonely place, where the only sounds to be heard are the howls of the desert wind itself. The great vastness of this inhospitable desert is peppered with the odd canyon here and there. Yet, one of these canyons is not like the others. It stands out from the rest. An array of high energy defensive towers seem to be guarding something within one of this secluded canyon, and there's only one way to uncover its secrets. As the old adage goes: "Nothing ventured, nothing gained."
3004.UnlockTips: Complete 100% of "The Howling Wastes" within the Wandering Balloon.

132.Name: Tempestuous Twisters
132.Description: The Bastion of the Elements is situated to the east of the Dark Forest. It is a turbulent region where elementals are born and reside. The atmosphere within the region is suffused with strong elemental particles, which often brew up frightening and uncontrollable storms. When violent elemental winds clash with warmer winds, mother nature gives birth to a frightening and violent being known as a tempestuous twister. With such unbridled power, twisters are hard to dispel, even for those most in-tune with nature. The only feasible option is to harness these twisters' power and bring them under control.

3005.Name: Fallen Souls
3005.Description: The land between the empire of men and the undead, nothing more than an abandoned waste, home only to the fallen souls. Horror's Eve looms closer and with it, so do the terrors that lurk in the darkness. This is no place for anyone, much less two foolish girls...
3005.UnlockTips: Complete 100% of "Fallen Souls" within the Wandering Balloon.

133.Name: The Snowy Front
133.Description: During the harsh winters of Esperia, the Frozen Mother, Alna, stands atop the highest peaks, sending icy winds cascading down the mountains. The blizzards sweep across the land, a solemn reminder that peace should never be taken for granted. But as the echoes of war fade, her warning has softened into something else: a celebration of resilience. People gather in the snowfall, singing the Frozen Mother's winter hymn, exchanging gifts and heartfelt wishes. Warmhearted souls hitch their sleighs to young deer, handing out presents to every child. Yet behind the laughter and festivities, the Hypogean threat is ever-present. Far beyond these peaceful lands, warriors still stand at the frontlines, clad in armor, locked in battle against relentless foes. Ding ding ding—the sleighs set off. This time, they carry more than just children's gifts. They are laden with supplies and tokens of gratitude, bound for those who guard the borders, ensuring they too can find warmth in the bitter cold.

1012.Name: The Hazy Timberland
1012.Description: Many folk have gotten lost within these hazy woods. Enshrouded by a mist that refuses to disperse, wanderers are often left to roam until they wander into an early grave. The thick mist has been said to hide great riches, left behind by the wanderers that weren't fortunate enough to escape the woods' hazy grasp. One must stay vigilant in such a confusing and peculiar landscape. One lapse in concentration and a traveler could become lost forever.

129.Name: The Arid Badlands
129.Description:
The topography of the Badlands is full of twists, turns and heavy sandstorms that blot out the sun, bringing darkness on all who stand below.
        Situated at the edge of the Lightbearer's border, the Arid Badlands is pocketed with rich deposits of varying magical ores. Forging equipment out of these magical ores can greatly enhance a warrior's might, thus, they are a highly sought after commodity. It is for this very reason that this important cargo requires a military escort.
        Not only that, but due to the unexpected and unstable nature of these magical ores, great care is needed to transport them. Knowing of the ores' dangers, the ingenious dwarven engineers set up many safety checks along their railroads to ensure that the precious cargo reaches its destination in one piece.

2015.Name: Arena of Trials
2015.Description: The Arena of Trials is a place brimming with magical energy. In some ways, it doesn't truly exist in the real world. It's more like a fantastical mirage born of magic. Yet the dangers within this mirage are all too real. With trial upon trial and ordeal after ordeal, those who have successfully obtained the treasure are a precious few indeed!

1013.Name: The Depths of Time 2
1013.Description: Within this region lies a town called Evercrest. Its inhabitants possess a unique skill to talk with the dead, a rare and unusual skill. These folk have branded as heretics by the Temple of Light, thus the temple clerics ordered the town to be cleansed. Years later, the town's story has still yet to be concluded, as demonic invaders march toward the township.

3006.Name: The Frosted Expanse
3006.Description:
Winter comes and with it so does the Frozen Mother's embrace. The lush green fields of Esperia give way to the snowy blankets that she gifts to us.
    Rows of snow-covered pine trees sit silently beside their protectors, the snowmen of midwinter, waiting patiently to greet the midwinter travelers on their way through the valley.
    Yet not all is well in the frosted expanse, as a malicious creature lurks in the shadows, plotting to turn serenity into chaos, its true intentions still unknown.
3006.UnlockTips: Complete 100% of "The Frosted Expanse" within the Wandering Balloon.

134.Name: Dreamscape
134.Description:
Desires are spoken to us through our dreams.
The Dreamscape is a place where one's desires are reflected. Many dangerous desires reside within the realm of the ephemeral, waiting to be realized.
Tasi, the guardian of dreams has sensed a dangerous dream forming within an unknown mind. This particular dreamscape is shrouded in a darkness that refuses to disperse. If she does not act quickly, these nefarious thoughts may become more than just simple ideas, they may eventually affect the real world.
It would seem that the brooding darkness has already attracted two visitors from another dimension.
Two experts that understand the heart and mind very well.

2016.Name: Arena of Trials
2016.Description: The Arena of Trials is a place brimming with magical energy. In some ways, it doesn't truly exist in the real world. It's more like a fantastical mirage born of magic. Yet the dangers within this mirage are all too real. With trial upon trial and ordeal after ordeal, those who have successfully obtained the treasure are a precious few indeed!

3007.Name: The Forest's Edge
3007.Description: Just as a squirrel buries its food, so do the dwarves stash their treasures. Located at the edge of the forest seems to be what looks like the remnants of an old dwarven mine. Scattered throughout the area, are small, winding paths that may hide hidden dangers... or perhaps treasures. Only the brave or foolish will know for sure.
3007.UnlockTips: Complete 100% of the Wandering Balloon's "The Forest's Edge"

136.Name: Fields of Ice
136.Description: Brewmaster Rigby Brown has set out in search of remnants of an old Dwarven region known as the Frozen Prairie, but what he seeks is not what most people desire. Rigby has only one thing on his mind, a new and special type of brew! Armed with an excellent sense of smell, Rigby is determined to sniff out the prize he so desires, leaving empty-handed is not a consideration. You get what you put in, that's Rigby's motto. Despite the frosty conditions, young Rowan has also joined Rigby on his adventure in the hopes of capitalizing on this special brew.

2017.Name: Arena of Trials
2017.Description: The Arena of Trials is a place brimming with magical energy. In some ways, it doesn't truly exist in the real world. It's more like a fantastical mirage born of magic. Yet the dangers within this mirage are all too real. With trial upon trial and ordeal after ordeal, those who have successfully obtained the treasure are a precious few indeed!

3008.Name: Frozen Ground
3008.Description: What used to be a land teeming with life has been frozen white by the rapacious frost of the ice elementals. Arden managed to defeat them some years ago to usher in four seasons of equally wonderful weather. I just don't know how the bound elementals escaped. The starving wildlife has abandoned this area. Now snow is about to blanket everything once again.
3008.UnlockTips: Complete 100% of the Wandering Balloon's "Frozen Ground"

139.Name: Blighted Highlands
139.Description:
After the Frozen Mother's howling had ceased, the winter ice began to thaw, allowing for Flora's Spring warmth to be ushered into Esperia once more. However, as nature flourishes, so does an Ice Elemental. Without any warning, a turbulent elemental has appeared at the heart of the Lightbearer Empire, which is causing havoc, destroying everything and everyone that it comes into contact with.
        The Ice Elemental has slowed the coming of Spring. Its icy winds have laid waste to young Spring saplings, killing them before they even had a chance at life. If the Ice Elemental is not dealt with quickly, the whole of Esperia may find itself suffering from a great famine very soon.
    In order to save Spring, brave heroes must meet head on with the Ice Elemental to snuff out the danger with which it threatens the world, before it's too late.

2018.Name: Arena of Trials
2018.Description: The Arena of Trials is a place brimming with magical energy. In some ways, it doesn't truly exist in the real world. It's more like a fantastical mirage born of magic. Yet the dangers within this mirage are all too real. With trial upon trial and ordeal after ordeal, those who have successfully obtained the treasure are a precious few indeed!

3009.Name: The Frozen Hinterland
3009.Description: A place of perpetual coldness, where only the sound of snowfall can be heard. Legend has it, that the snowy highland terrain can change in an instant whenever the snow ceases to fall, laying bear the true lay of the land for all to witness. One wonders, what will be seen this time?
3009.UnlockTips: Complete 100% of "The Frozen Hinterland" within the Wandering Balloon.

137.Name: The Fractured Gallery
137.Description:
The Fractured Gallery is the sole pathway to ancient miracles.
       Yet, it is wrought with curses, and within it exists an a barrier that is difficult to surmount. 
       The Fractured Gallery exists to protect the miracles behind it.
       It curses all those who wish to pass through it and peer into the miracles.
       The "secret treasure" hidden in the Fractured Gallery lures avaricious, risk-taking explorers into disorientation, causing them to become lost, or even leading them to their demise, as they venture deeper and deeper...

141.Name: The Depths of Time III
141.Description:
This time, the two swirling whirlpools of sand in the demonic hourglass correspond to the present and the future. Mortals, sand... there is no difference between them. Each grain looks the same, but nothing can halt its flow through time. Suppose you were blessed with foresight, would you steer a ship clear of its impending doom? Did the story unfold differently, or was it that your 'foresight' was a part of the tale all along? A beautiful port town, a crisis concealed by clouds, a glimpse of a fate... is it karma? You will be a unique grain of sand, able to traverse the hourglass at will, past and present as you please. Each of your encounters will weave the threads of fate, every single connection will prove crucial. You must exercise extreme caution. Search, destroy, redeem... explore the source and the finale of all the blood-soaked resentment...
"Go on then, go face it... You! It's your fate!"

2019.Name: Arena of Trials
2019.Description: The Arena of Trials is a place brimming with magical energy. In some ways, it doesn't truly exist in the real world. It's more like a fantastical mirage born of magic. Yet the dangers within this mirage are all too real. With trial upon trial and ordeal after ordeal, those who have successfully obtained the treasure are a precious few indeed!

4000.Name: The Forest Escapade
4000.Description:
A little racoon called Raku lives in the Dark Forest, cozy in his tree-hole home, called "Nutshell Nook".
       The first time Raku brought a friend into the Dark Forest from the outside realm, he never expected that they'd get swallowed by the illusory mist of the Phantom Veil Thicket, and wound up lost and confused!
       The Phantom Veil Thicket surrounds the Dark Forest, enshrouding everything in a thick mist that never dissipates no matter the season. In that mist are illusions, created to keep non-forest folk out of the Dark Forest, ensnaring them in vivid falsehoods and driving them out in confusion.
       The Phantom Veil Thicket used to be a simple barrier of protective nature magic. However, right now the mystical powers of the Thicket have "trapped" Raku and his outsider guest. Will they be able to find a way out?

3010.Name: The Depths of Time 2
3010.Description: Within this region lies a town called Evercrest. Its inhabitants possess a unique skill to talk with the dead, a rare and unusual skill. These folk have branded as heretics by the Temple of Light, thus the temple clerics ordered the town to be cleansed. Years later, the town's story has still yet to be concluded, as demonic invaders march toward the township.
3010.UnlockTips: Complete 100% of "The Depths of Time II" within the Wandering Balloon.

143.Name: Roamers' Rhapsody
143.Description:
Angelo travelled all across the land making a great many friends who shared in his love of music.
The Noble Tavern is about the hold a grand music festival, and Angelo has entrusted you to deliver the invites.
        Here's where it gets tricky... He only knows their nicknames, "Soul Singer", "The Musical Rose", "Kingpin" and "Pop Prodigy". He doesn't have a clue what their real names are, let alone where to find them. 
        Seems there's nothing else for it but to start the search! First, let's look for the music-loving Wilder.
        First stop, the Dark Forest!

135.Name: Art of Conquest
135.Description: Everyone knows that the Empire's Imperial Military Barracks are well-known for turning average citizens into well-disciplined, resolute soldiers. The military established "Battle Trials" to test the knowledge that these soldiers carry, to determine whether or not they can use this knowledge to overcome their enemies. The Battle Trials encompasses many realistic challenges that soldiers may actually encounter while roaming Esperia. The adversaries within the trial aren't your average foes, they possess the power of the arcane, and there are many magically imbued War Relics to be found within the trial. The foes within the trial are abnormally strong, and in most cases cannot be fought head on. Only by using patience, opportunity and wit, can they be bested. With the proper utilization of War Relics, the weak can overcome the strong and clench victory from the jaws of defeat. This is the Art of Conquest.

1014.Name: The Echoing Valley
1014.Description: The Echoing Valley, a place full of winding roads and few trees. Not much is able to live in this region. Tales speak of an ancient battle occurring on this very land, a battle which gave the region its namesake. Due to the very nature of the rock formations here, artillery and explosions would echo throughout the valley for an extraordinarily long time, causing the terrifying sounds of war to haunt the men that fought here long after the battle had ended. Some say even today, the echoes of war can still be heard reverberating around the Echoing Valley.
1014.UnlockTips: Complete 60% of "The Depths of Time II"

The thick mist has been said to hide great riches, left behind by the wanderers that weren't fortunate enough to escape the woods' hazy grasp. One must stay vigilant in such a confusing and peculiar landscape. One lapse in concentration and a traveler could become lost forever.
3011.UnlockTips: Complete 100% of "The Hazy Timberland" within the Wandering Balloon.

138.Name: The Hunting Trail
138.Description:
In the howl of the biting frozen winds, the curtain never falls on the tale of the Wolf and the Sheep.
    Dueling Blasters at the ready, she marched on in the direction her demonic quarry had vanished. Exasperated by the snowfall concealing and confounding the beast's tracks, she cursed. A huge coffin gradually appeared behind her as Fawkes calmly analyzed their surroundings from beneath the brim of his hat, piecing together clues with his eagle eyes.
    Fawkes raised his crossbow and pointed North-west, a resolve in his eyes that Raine knew and trusted without reservation.
    With their capes fluttering in the gale winds, the Bounty Hunters pressed on in their pursuit.

145.Name: Price of Rebirth
145.Description: Grezhul was assassinated in an attempt on Thoran's life, it was indeed a bloody coup. Verging on the precipice between life and death, a voice rings out, something about a 'soul deal'. Grezhul understood the price, but such was the depth of his desire for revenge that it was not too steep. His hand forced, he agrees to the disembodied voice's terms...

1015.Name: Track of the Sands
1015.Description: The Track of the Sands, also known as the Quarry Rail, was originally developed to transport rare minerals out of nearby mines. It is operated by the Imperial Freight Company, owned by the richest man in the empire, Reginald Gilder. After decades of operation, the Track of the Sands has become an increasingly important overland freight rout,.transporting vast quantities of industrial and military supplies every year. However, perhaps because the track is known to be owned by a very rich man, many more remote spots on the track are targeted for ambush by raiders hoping to steal the goods and ransom the train staff.

146.Name: Void Rift
146.Description: A small town on the edges of the Lightbearer's dominion finds itself being slowly eroded by a mysterious dark force. The land is slowly being eaten away at, a foreboding sign of an impending invasion. Although once weakened, disciples of this dark force still roam the world, with their evil intentions forever unceasing. After years of laying in wait, the disciples have risen once more to create a nefarious pentagram that is able to bend and break the fabric of reality, ushering in a new malevolence in from the Void Realm. In order to uphold order within the realm, heroes must step into this distorted land which has been infected by the Void Realm. Only by repelling this infectious force that permeates this land, can order be reinstated.

3012.Description: The Track of the Sands, also known as the Quarry Rail, was originally developed to transport rare minerals out of nearby mines. 3012.UnlockTips: Complete 100% of "Track of the Sands" within the Wandering Balloon.

1016.Name: Windfall Gorge
1016.Description:
North of the desert is Windfall Gorge, a perilous place believed to be entirely unreachable.
 Storms twist and swirl atop the towering peaks of the surrounding cliffs. Even the most experienced desert guides struggle to find a route into the Gorge, so it's no surprise that even the most willful would-be wanderer will find themselves at a total loss...

149.Name: Ice Isles
149.Description:
The Ice Isles are situated to the North East of the ever-changing Jade Reef Bay, reaching it only takes a few hours by sea, although not many folk would want to visit the isles these days.
        However, the Ice Isles were not always known by the same name as they are today. These isles were once a major transit point of the maritime trade routes, but during a fierce arcane war of yesteryear, the elemental equilibrium of the isles was completely devastated, thus, ice and snow now prevails, covering the whole landscape.
        No longer is life capable of surviving in such extremes, what were once lush green fields and woods are now nothing more than a barren desert. Few people know of the sleeping volcano that lays hidden deep beneath the thick icy exterior of the island.
        Lately the volcano has been showing new signs of life, there are signs of fire again on the frigid Ice Isles.

142.Name: Ancient Seal
142.Description:
In those days of malevolence, three brave men - a swordsman, a mage and a craftsman - fought to defend their home. Employing their exceptional skill and wisdom, they crushed the demon's minions, pursuing them all the way to the cavern hideout, planning of destroying the demon that threatened their home. After the battle, the demon fell into a deep slumber, the exhausted warriors, unable to finish it off were left with no choice but to seal it away. In order to end the threat once and for all, the mage and craftsman transformed the cave where the demon rests and established a rigorous trial. They hoped that in the future, brave individuals of considerable talent and power would be able to totally eradicate the demon scourge.
Centuries later, the exploits of those three brave men have descended into rumor, a jumble of truth and fiction falling from the mouths of drunkards. Little do they know, the demon is about to stir...

3013.Name: The Echoing Valley
3013.Description: The Echoing Valley, a place full of winding roads and few trees. Not much is able to live in this region. Tales speak of an ancient battle occurring on this very land, a battle which gave the region its namesake. Due to the very nature of the rock formations here, artillery and explosions would echo throughout the valley for an extraordinarily long time, causing the terrifying sounds of war to haunt the men that fought here long after the battle had ended. Some say even today, the echoes of war can still be heard reverberating around the Echoing Valley.
3013.UnlockTips: Complete 100% of "The Echoing Valley" within the Wandering Balloon.

1017.Name: Black Woods
1017.Description:
The Black Woods are located at the edge of the Lightbearer Empire. Since the Graveborn gained a foothold in the wastelands of the old kingdom of Bantus, they have been able to equal the Lightbearer's strength. King Thoran ordered his subjects to initiate a series of probing attacks against the Lightbearers, and the Black Woods was an ideal location to undertake such attacks.
       The Lightbearer frontier forces stationed within the Black Woods were no match for the Graveborn's numbers. Again and again, Lightbearer forces were pushed back, forced to retreat. The Lightbearers had no choice but to rely on the conscripted soldiers of nearby villages while they waited for the Divine Temple's righteous warriors, the Temple clerics to arrive. The Graveborn, fearing nothing more than the Divine Light were gradually pushed back and subdued once the Temple clerics had arrived. Now only the remnants of this bygone era remain.

151.Name: Forgotten Ruins
151.Description:
A sunken land, a fallen temple. The pure white Divine Light fades with each passing day. The beleaguered souls of the dead saw the light once more and surged towards it while they still had the chance. A small corner of the region reveals a place of great divinity that has since fallen into obscurity, and over time become forgotten.
        Emissaries of the Light have arrived in the area to seek out any traces of mankind's forgotten past.

148.Name: The Final Night
148.Description:
The final night of roaming the remote island is finally upon them. After days of fumbling for answers, the Heroes have finally found the key to eliminating the endless storm. The root of everything is the broiling heat deep within the volcano.
        Amidst growing suspicions and jealousies, the Heroes venture out to the Volcano, eliminating the source of it all and seeking a way to return home. Yet, lurking shadows are following not far behind, and with them the final encounter...

1018.Name: The Sandy Tracks
1018.Description: As a region of great significance and vast resources, the Sandy Tracks is greatly valued by the Lightbearer high command. The mines spread throughout this region provide precious metals that the Lightbearer regiments so dearly require. After the dwarves were welcomed into the Lightbearer alliance, they swiftly constructed mines and rail tracks, many of which are protected by their ingeniously crafted Safety Gates and Checkpoints. Used for decades, the Safety Gates have prevented many would-be plunderers from stealing the king's resources land.

4001.Name: Island of Solitude
4001.Description:
A peculiar and ghastly ocean anomaly has caused the valiant heroes to become stranded upon the Island of Solitude.
      With no way of contacting civilization, the heroes find themselves on a peculiar island all alone, or so they think. A shortage of supplies, hidden enemies, and disaster after disaster striking the heroes has left them all at their wits' end. The heroes know that if they are to survive, they must cultivate fruit and catch fish, these things are paramount to survival. Only by having the bare necessities of survival, can they then turn their focus towards repairing their wrecked ship and returning home.
       However, a plot is brewing, and the hero's shall be tested in ways they never thought possible...

147.Name: Lost in the Wild
147.Description:
Zzz...
Fwoooo - the soft wind pirouettes through the leaves.
Rustling in the depths of the forest shade, beneath a large fallen tree, illuminated by rays of sunlight,
there are two small furry creatures, their heads close together as if whispering secrets.
