1019.Name: Mirael's Nightmare
1019.Description: The Burning Light, also known as Mirael is regarded as one of the deadliest bounty hunters in the realm. Her temperament is just as fiery as her bright red hair. Her fiery magic is sometimes too powerful for even herself to keep under control. Yet, in comparison to her youth, it could be say that Mirael has made leaps and bounds when it came to controlling her temper and powers. As a student, Mirael would often cause her teachers at the Astral Academy headaches with her wanton destruction of school property. In order to control her, the teachers would have to occasionally send to "Detention" rooms, where her powers would be somewhat constrained. As far as Mirael was concerned, she might as well have been in a living nightmare, without her power, she felt empty. This nightmare was one she wished she'd never have to experience again.

154.Name: The Sealing Sword
154.Description: From a remote corner of the land, a long-forgotten town sends a plea for help, claiming that nearby Hypogeans are stirring, about to break through the town's defenses. The Lightbearer Empire intends to send troops to suppress the scourge, but the rugged mountain roads are hindering the army's advance. In desperation, the Empire issued a commission to bounty hunters, calling for heroes to wipeout the Hypogeans and save the town from ruin. The long-neglected town welcomed new visitors. Stepping into the town, they realized that the situation here is far more complex than the request for help had implied...

2031.Name: Arena of Trials
2031.Description: The Arena of Trials is a place brimming with magical energy. In some ways, it doesn't truly exist in the real world. It's more like a fantastical mirage born of magic. Yet the dangers within this mirage are all too real. With trial upon trial and ordeal after ordeal, those who have successfully obtained the treasure are a precious few indeed!

2026.Name: Arena of Trials
2026.Description: The Arena of Trials is a place brimming with magical energy. In some ways, it doesn't truly exist in the real world. It's more like a fantastical mirage born of magic. Yet the dangers within this mirage are all too real. With trial upon trial and ordeal after ordeal, those who have successfully obtained the treasure are a precious few indeed!

152.Name: Gold Rush
152.Description:
The Pioneer Route is a necessary path for businessmen to reach the Paradise of Wealth.
  This route is constantly traveled by merchants, but recently, a mysterious little thief has appeared here. His nostrils flaring, constantly sniffing, eager for every glittering treasures, his sticky little fingers will do whatever it takes to hold on to that alluring gold...

1020.Name: The Dusty Barrens
1020.Description:
The Dusty Barrens, although on the surface is a sparse and hostile environment, hides many precious and vital resources. Privy to this knowledge, the dwarves would harvest the land's precious resources to provide arms for the King's Army.
However, as a barren desert, moving such massive amounts of mineral ore would not be an easy task, thus, the dwarves created their own highly efficient rail system. Traversing such a hostile land would not be easy, but luckily enough, this is what the dwarves do best.

2025.Name: Arena of Trials
2025.Description: The Arena of Trials is a place brimming with magical energy. In some ways, it doesn't truly exist in the real world. It's more like a fantastical mirage born of magic. Yet the dangers within this mirage are all too real. With trial upon trial and ordeal after ordeal, those who have successfully obtained the treasure are a precious few indeed!

156.Name: Demonic Incursions
156.Description: The frontiers of the Lightbearer Empire were always fractious, the garrisons here act as a solid wall, protecting every inch of the empire's territory. This time, the Frontier Commander of the garrisoned forces was ordered to lead his army to clear the frontier of the evil that was trying to encroach upon the emperor's land, but by doing so he stumbled into a deadly trap, and finds himself surrounded by nefarious demons on all sides. The commander made a quick decision set up camp to buy time for his men, and to look for ways of breaking through the siege. Food and water is about to run out, and the demons are getting closer and closer with each passing hour. On the brink of defeat, the emergence of two brave Wilders has given the Commander what he and his men need most: renewed hope.

2027.Name: Arena of Trials
2027.Description: The Arena of Trials is a place brimming with magical energy. In some ways, it doesn't truly exist in the real world. It's more like a fantastical mirage born of magic. Yet the dangers within this mirage are all too real. With trial upon trial and ordeal after ordeal, those who have successfully obtained the treasure are a precious few indeed!

3015.Name: Black Woods
3015.Description:
The Black Woods are located at the edge of the Lightbearer Empire. Since the Graveborn gained a foothold in the wastelands of the old kingdom of Bantus, they have been able to equal the Lightbearer's strength. King Thoran ordered his subjects to initiate a series of probing attacks against the Lightbearers, and the Black Woods was an ideal location to undertake such attacks.
       The Lightbearer frontier forces stationed within the Black Woods were no match for the Graveborn's numbers. Again and again, Lightbearer forces were pushed back, forced to retreat. The Lightbearers had no choice but to rely on the conscripted soldiers of nearby villages while they waited for the Divine Temple's righteous warriors, the Temple clerics to arrive. The Graveborn, fearing nothing more than the Divine Light were gradually pushed back and subdued once the Temple clerics had arrived. Now only the remnants of this bygone era remain.
3015.UnlockTips: Complete 100% of "Black Woods" within the Wandering Balloon.

153.Name: The Forgotten Frontier
153.Description:
Historical records cite that the Lightbearer Empire paid a hefty price in order to keep the undead out of the Black Woods.
        But there are no unbreakable walls - not on borders, nor in people's temples of faith.
        In the cold winds of the forest, the seeds of death have quietly fallen to the ground, taking root and sprouting into an evil unmatched. The decaying soil is stained an acidic green, its noxiousness so vile that no mortal can pass over it. 
    These Spectral Wastes block passage through to many places, and must be avoided at all costs.
    All horrors leave scars on the land.

2030.Name: Arena of Trials
2030.Description: The Arena of Trials is a place brimming with magical energy. In some ways, it doesn't truly exist in the real world. It's more like a fantastical mirage born of magic. Yet the dangers within this mirage are all too real. With trial upon trial and ordeal after ordeal, those who have successfully obtained the treasure are a precious few indeed!

1021.Name: Cinder Grottoes
1021.Description:
The Cinder Grottoes are on the site of an ancient palace.
       After the merciless magic bombings of several hundred years of The Cinder War, the earth was torn asunder and the palace collapsed into ruins. The enduring war had an overwhelmingly negative impact on humanity, and many of their greatest achievements and finest architecture were destroyed - the history books and ancient records gone with them.
       Although the Cinder Grottoes are dilapidated, it's rumored they still hide many ancient magic tomes. Doubtless, the Esperian Order of the Sun were lured here by such rare knowledge.
       In order to find the lost magic of the Cinder Grottoes, the Order of the Sun send a number of their mages to search the place. Unfortunately, only one of them survived. After hearing from the survivor of a terrible monster waiting inside, the Lightbearer temple sent in a team to exorcise the lurking creature. In the dark depths, the two forces must both act cautiously in the face of unseen dangers.

157.Name: The Road Home
157.Description: Fawkes received a mysterious commission that required his presence in a remote town. The task, destroy nearby evil. Catching word of this, Raine felt a distinct sense of unease at the prospect of her friend going solo, so she decided to accompany Fawkes on this job...

2029.Name: Arena of Trials
2029.Description: The Arena of Trials is a place brimming with magical energy. In some ways, it doesn't truly exist in the real world. It's more like a fantastical mirage born of magic. Yet the dangers within this mirage are all too real. With trial upon trial and ordeal after ordeal, those who have successfully obtained the treasure are a precious few indeed!

155.Name: The Setting Sun
155.Description:
Sunsetton is a fairytale town with fertile soil and bountiful harvests located on the southern fringe of the Black Woods.
More fabled than the town itself is the local Captain of the Guard, Snault. He was an upstanding and brave soldier possessing incorruptible faith. He was once Hogan's loyal subordinate, but because of his excessive integrity, Snault came to offend many people. In a military power purge, Snault was transferred far from the garrison, and has since been Captain of the guard at the town of "Sunsetton".
Snault is not only a great friend to Lucius, but also a faithful believer. Since childhood, the Divine Light shone favor upon their friendship. Thus, having heard news of Snault's apparent disappearance, Lucius summoned all his courage to request that he accompany General Hogan on his investigation in Sunsetton.

1022.Name: The Realm of Denial
1022.Description:
The Realm of Denial is a special space between Esperia and the realms of the dead. Spirits still clinging onto the world, unwilling to die yet unable to be revived, gather here in hopes of breaking through into the world of the living. The memories of these lost wandering souls have been long since engulfed in the tides of time - they know not who they are or where they are from, existing and acting only on obsession, lingering eternally in the Realm of Denial.
Every year, a small opening forms in the Realm of Denial, giving lost souls the opportunity to visit the place that peaks their obsessions. The children of Esperia, meanwhile, spend the day dressing up as ghosts, going from door to door to ask for candy.
On this night, the Celestial Twins of Esperia, Lailah and Elijah, come to the Realm of Denial in order to guide lost spirits towards completing their unfinished business.
1022.UnlockTips: Over 60% progress on the instance "Cinder Grottoes"

158.Name: Land of Frozen Lakes
158.Description: Tasi and Pippa are guided by a dream to a small land filled with frozen lakes. Here, they rescue a young girl who has been separated from someone important to her in order to crush Ezizh Hellborn's sinister schemes. However, it seems that things are not too simple...

159.Name: The Icy Garden
159.Description:
Winter has arrived and dressed the land in a fine silvery gown. The warming sunlight from above paints the snow gold.
"Magnificent! As if the floor were paved with gold." Our astute young businessman narrows his eyes, thinking of a brilliant way to turn a profit.

1023.Name: Deathly Marshlands
1023.Description:
It was nearly a thousand years ago that a great battle erupted on this ancient battleground, a place where thousands of nameless souls found their final resting place. 
       Once a lush forest, the elements were not kind to this land. Now, all that remains is an unending marshland that spans as far as the eye can see. Pungent smells and gases assail the nostrils and obscure one's sight. The bubbling viscous undergrowth clings to any would-be adventurers, as if it were alive, refusing to relinquish its grasp on them.
       Although beset with its danger, the marsh does little to discourage the reckless and foolhardy adventurers that traverse it. Being the only way to the southern island, they have no choice but to accept the risk. Could the treasures hidden on the island be worth dying for?

166.Name: The Foreboding Disaster
166.Description: An eerie cold has descended upon a remote village, hidden deep in the forest, turning the once vibrant forest into a frigid tundra. Two bounty hunters have been commissioned to investigate the situation, yet after stepping into the forest, they discovered that things are not as simple as they'd originally thought. An abandoned village, mysterious enemies, a broken magical array, scattered feathers, all lay under the cover of snow, waiting for the truth to be uncovered.

4002.Name: The Tormented Reach
4002.Description:
In the encounter with Framton, the Solaris Flare that Talene was so immensely proud of, was crushed by the fiendish Hypogean. As the moment of truth was upon her, Talene finally looked inwards, discovering that her Inner Sanctum has been long shrouded in a festering gloom. The death of her mother, her feeble former self, her obsession with revenge, and the weight of her ancestors' expectations... For years on end, Talene has been at the mercy of her Inner Demons, polluting her Solaris Flare with unwelcome distractions and impure thoughts.
There is no time to lose, those Inner Demons must be exorcised and peace restored to her Inner Sanctum. The battle is just beginning...

1024.Name: Bridge of Souls
1024.Description:
There is no group of people throughout the whole of Esperia like the dwarfs. The dwarfs are the hardiest folk to have ever graced of Esperia. Their townships lay in waste, their castles crumbled and their lands smoldered. Such a terrible fate, brought upon them by malevolent, demonic invaders, yet not once did the dwarfs' resolve dwindle. No man or demon shall ever subjugate a dwarf. Never. The world has not been kind to the dwarves, but they march on, ever resolute.
Today was the day that Morvus, The Far Stalker, would bring the ashes of his fallen brethren to the Bridge of Souls, the only path to every dwarven warrior's final resting place, a place where they enter their eternal slumber. Morvus must raise the Bridge of Souls to gain passage to the dwarfs' sacred burial grounds. Anything less would be a dishonor to his fallen brethren.

168.Name: Tundra Trouble
168.Description: In the frozen snowscape of the icy tundras, Pippa came across an elderly man mired by the frosty winds and snow, rushing to make it back to his home. Although he assured Pippa he would be fine alone and his home was nearby, Pippa's kind-hearted nature would never allow her to see him left alone, so she endeavored to accompany him there...

163.Name: The Sunken City
163.Description: This marine city named Bonnpei was built by some glorious ancient civilization. Thanks to their incredibly sophisticated and intricate drainage system, they tamed the tides and turned it to their advantage, as a way to safeguard their incredible city. However, when an evil descended that surpassed even the gods themselves, humanity were powerless to fend them off with their paltry technologies. When the tentacles of evil tore the land asunder, the ancient city was engulfed, swallowed entirely by the oceanic sea in a single night. Thousands of years passed and the tides gradually subsided, finally allowing the world to glimpse the true face of the ancient city. The once prosperous metropolis was now merely a salty ruin, its final swan song to a golden era was the intricate drainage system that continues to function. Exactly what the reappearance of these ruins means for the world is unknown, but there is one certainty - there will be treasure. Some would be discouraged by the sight of such a place, a shadow of its former glory, yet there are others who sense opportunity...

162.Name: The Arid Lands
162.Description:
The last rains of the southwestern region of the Scorched Expanse happened so long ago that they have almost been forgotten. Satrana, learning of this terrible situation, became eager to lend a hand and do something to aid those suffering.
But great acts require great participants, so the witty mage rolled her eyes as she thought long and hard about who would be a reliable enough accomplice, and once again she thought of no one better than the person she saw as a mother-figure...

1025.Name: Tempestuous Twisters
1025.Description: The Bastion of the Elements is situated to the east of the Dark Forest. It is a turbulent region where elementals are born and reside. The atmosphere within the region is suffused with strong elemental particles, which often brew up frightening and uncontrollable storms. When violent elemental winds clash with warmer winds, mother nature gives birth to a frightening and violent being known as a tempestuous twister. With such unbridled power, twisters are hard to dispel, even for those most in-tune with nature. The only feasible option is to harness these twisters' power and bring them under control.

1026.Name: The Snowy Front
1026.Description:
The Midwinter Festival is one of Esperia's most important holidays. It's when The Frozen Mother, Alna sings her winter song and ushers forth winter from the lofty highlands down onto Esperia's lowlands, layering the whole world in a thick blanket of snow.
       The first snowfall of the year is cause for great celebrations allover the realm. People come together to sing songs about Alna, trees are decorated with beautifully exquisite trinkets, gifts are exchanged amongst one another and the children happily build snowmen outside. Gifts and cards are sent between towns with the help of deer and their trusty sledges, ensuring every child receives a present.
       Although most denizens of Esperia rest and relax during this period, the Hypogeans that threaten the Esperian way of life choose not to cease their onslaught. It is only because of the brave warriors on the frontline of the frontier lands, that families are able to rejoice in the relative safety of their warm homes.
       *Ding Ding Ding* The sledge has departed for the frontlines. The great warriors on the frontline must not be forgotten in such dire times. Presents, food and much-needed necessities are on their way to them.

502.Name: Nightmare Infinitum
502.Description: Coming from a poor rural village, Andersson clawed his way to the top and finally found success as a merchant with his own shop in the city. One day like any other, he returned home from sorting his inventory and lay his tired body in bed for a good night's sleep. However, after comfortably drifting into a dream, a force of evil steps in to seize an opportunity...

164.Name: Demonic Devastation
164.Description: Far off in the remotest reaches of the ocean stands an archipelago that has fallen into the hands of wretched Hypogeans. Seirus, on his oceanic patrol, heard word of this place and decided to call in his old friend, Gorvo, to join him in investigating the matter. If the rumor happens to be true, then his trusty weapon will ensure the Hypogeans meet a fitting end.

4003.Name: Lost Grace
4003.Description: A banquet and dance to commemorate the victory of The First Hypogean War is being held in Oakenfell. While the crowd indulges in singing and dancing, there is an unexpected outburst. The apparel that is supposed to be displayed at the banquet has been stolen, and the suspect arrested is... Rosaline!? The absurdity of the verdict made Oscar unable to stand idly by. The only way to clear Rosaline's good name is to find the real culprit! The lost apparel, the quiet city lord, a departing carriage... Muddled in such a haze, nothing seems believable and the truth is enshrouded in questions and doubts. Now, it is time for Oscar to take action!

299.Name: The Parade
299.Description:
This year's celebration will be held in the artistic atmosphere of Oakenfell. Oscar, who coordinates all the tasks and strive for excellence, will be handing over the preparations for the banquet to a certain maid of honor.
Rosaline, solely responsible for something important for the first time ever, can't help but panic.
Thank goodness her Broom of Vitality is there for support! He'll help Rosaline with useful hints.
Firstly, she needs to go to the venue and get involved...

503.Name: The Golden Isles
503.Description: Raine has been informed by Mirael that hidden in the depths of the ocean by an island there lays a treasure trove just awaiting discovery! Bounty Hunter Raine is not one to pass up a good opportunity, and immediately takes Fawkes along for the ride. Who could've predicted they'd be sailing headlong into a violent storm...

1027.Name: The Arid Badlands
1027.Description:
The topography of the Badlands is full of twists, turns and heavy sandstorms that blot out the sun, bringing darkness on all who stand below.
        Situated at the edge of the Lightbearer's border, the Arid Badlands is pocketed with rich deposits of varying magical ores. Forging equipment out of these magical ores can greatly enhance a warrior's might, thus, they are a highly sought after commodity. It is for this very reason that this important cargo requires a military escort.
        Not only that, but due to the unexpected and unstable nature of these magical ores, great care is needed to transport them. Knowing of the ores' dangers, the ingenious dwarven engineers set up many safety checks along their railroads to ensure that the precious cargo reaches its destination in one piece.

169.Name: Rising Winds
169.Description: Before the Gloria Spectacular celebration came to an end, a new crisis arose! Peculiar scars began to appear on Estrilda's body not long after an unknown creature had injured her, before she fell into a deep coma. Both the court physicians and the priests from the Temple of Light have been unable to heal her. Thane has decided to venture into The Dark Forest, to seek help from the Wilders, who have a deep understanding of herbal medicines. As a historian tells him about the origin of the scars, Thane realizes a catastrophe might soon strike every corner of Esperia.

298.Name: Lost Remnants
298.Description: A legend has spread from distant islands that there is a powerful treasure buried under mysterious Ancient Ruins. The Wind Whisperer, Lorsan, is introduced by Angelo and befriends an archaeologist, who is accompanying him to investigate the Ancient Ruins and its treasure.

1028.Name: Dreamscape
1028.Description:
Desires are spoken to us through our dreams.
The Dreamscape is a place where one's desires are reflected. Many dangerous desires reside within the realm of the ephemeral, waiting to be realized.
Tasi, the guardian of dreams has sensed a dangerous dream forming within an unknown mind. This particular dreamscape is shrouded in a darkness that refuses to disperse. If she does not act quickly, these nefarious thoughts may become more than just simple ideas, they may eventually affect the real world.
It would seem that the brooding darkness has already attracted two visitors from another dimension.
Two experts that understand the heart and mind very well.

301.Name: Runaway Crystabugs
301.Description: In much the same way that milk is produced by cows, the organic jelly extensively used in all spheres of the Lightbearer Empire life is produced by Crystabugs. Every year, the Imperial Capital's Crystabug Ranch catches the finest Crystabugs from the border for breeding. These big, rotund creatures are surprisingly tame, and are all capable of yielding jelly! However, this year the jelly delivery is running behind schedule and still hasn't been delivered to the Capital. It seems the feckless rancher has drunk too much Crystabrew again! He's too inebriated to do his job! Bandits abducted the seasoned Rancher and now the unattended Crystabugs have gotten loose and are scattered all over the place! The Bounty Hunter Guild has received a new commission: Round up the lost Crystabugs and take them back to the Imperial Capital. If you can, you should also bring back the troublemaking drunken Rancher!

170.Name: Equilibrium's Rift
170.Description:
It seemed inevitable that the first dwarven pioneers, groping around the mountains, would be associated with some rare wonder. While they were expanding the mine system all the way to the continent's borders, they discovered a magnificent chasm, a rift constantly belching subterranean steam. The unstable tectonic plates on either side of the rift balanced each other out, stabilizing the rift. This balance had to be maintained in order to exploit the steam.
To this end, the pioneers displayed truly heroic wisdom, by constructing perfectly symmetrical mines on both sides of the rift. Machinery on either side had to be connected too, ensuring that any operation would have an equal, mirrored action carried out on the opposite side. In this way, even cannons could be freely employed.
But the resurgence of Uemiss' minions has led to monsters roaming the mine. This panicked the miners, who abandoned the mine in search of a professional to help exterminate the interlopers. A generous prize of their concentrated, precious steam was offered to whoever was able to clear out the mines, be they traveler or bounty hunter.

1029.Name: Blighted Highlands
1029.Description:
After the Frozen Mother's howling had ceased, the winter ice began to thaw, allowing for Flora's Spring warmth to be ushered into Esperia once more. However, as nature flourishes, so does an Ice Elemental. Without any warning, a turbulent elemental has appeared at the heart of the Lightbearer Empire, which is causing havoc, destroying everything and everyone that it comes into contact with.
        The Ice Elemental has slowed the coming of Spring. Its icy winds have laid waste to young Spring saplings, killing them before they even had a chance at life. If the Ice Elemental is not dealt with quickly, the whole of Esperia may find itself suffering from a great famine very soon.
    In order to save Spring, brave heroes must meet head on with the Ice Elemental to snuff out the danger with which it threatens the world, before it's too late.

504.Name: The Corroded Frontier
504.Description: The Lightbearer Empire was engaged in a long tussle with the Graveborn in the Black Woods. Lasting several years, this war ended in the crushing defeat of the Graveborn. However, resurrected Graveborn are rousing from their slumber, quietly erecting Cannons set to eradicate the influence of the Divine Light Power left behind by the Temple. As they encroach further on the Black Woods, they aim to complete their unfinished business.

302.Name: The Blood Claw
302.Description: For years, Brutus The Blood Claw has been searching for his teacher Anasta, but to no avail. It's as if a pair of invisible hands have wiped her existence clean. As the elemental imbalance escalates, the Scorched Expanse is no longer free from its impact. It is at this time that Anasta finally shows up. Brutus follows the trail and battles against his teacher, the former Blood Claw. Master and apprentice are about to settle the score right here and now...

505.Name: The Frozen Forbidden Land
505.Description: Now a seemingly peaceful and wintry land, this is where the dwarves deployed their fortifications during the Hypogean War a thousand years ago to protect a secret in the depths of this forest. The buildings have been weathered and destroyed over the past millennium, and so has the secret of legend. At this time, the wandering Mishka accidently enters the depths of the forest and meets Pippa who has been walking around in circles. Will the two lost girls find the "treasures" left behind by the dwarves?

1030.Name: The Fractured Gallery
1030.Description:
The Fractured Gallery is the sole pathway to ancient miracles.
       Yet, it is wrought with curses, and within it exists an a barrier that is difficult to surmount. 
       The Fractured Gallery exists to protect the miracles behind it.
       It curses all those who wish to pass through it and peer into the miracles.
       The "secret treasure" hidden in the Fractured Gallery lures avaricious, risk-taking explorers into disorientation, causing them to become lost, or even leading them to their demise, as they venture deeper and deeper...

171.Name: Slow Night of Wonder
171.Description:
Message in a bottle:
Kind and courageous Princess Peggy, and her humble attendant Raku, we are from the Fantastic Conch Island, the native land of the Fantastic Conches. We have long heard about your heroic deeds in fighting against the evil forces of the world. Our beautiful home has been invaded and our people are suffering. Please come save us!
Yours truly,
The good people of the Fantastic Conch Island

4004.Name: High Summer Adventure
4004.Description: If you've heard of the myths of the Seven Seas, you'll definitely be familiar with the fearsome Reviled Captain. Over the years, countless ships have fallen under his cannons, but few avengers have been as determined as Captain Pufferfish. Now, Raku, Peggy, and friends have come to help Captain Pufferfish rebuild his ship and embark on a vengeful voyage. Will it be a successful revenge, or will they be buried at sea?

701.Name: Frozen Lava
701.Description: The equilibrium between the elements in Esperia is becoming more and more unbalanced and the once quiet Scorched Expanse has been thrust into disarray. What was once a verdant oasis has been obliterated by glaciation and lava flows. The local population of Maulers desperately reached out to the Temple of the Seers for assistance. The great elder of the Temple of the Seers, Numisu, had no choice but to emerge from isolation and travel to the Oasis with the Flame Weaver Satrana to take stock of the situation.

1031.Name: Roamers' Rhapsody
1031.Description:
Angelo travelled all across the land making a great many friends who shared in his love of music.
The Noble Tavern is about the hold a grand music festival, and Angelo has entrusted you to deliver the invites.
        Here's where it gets tricky... He only knows their nicknames, "Soul Singer", "The Musical Rose", "Kingpin" and "Pop Prodigy". He doesn't have a clue what their real names are, let alone where to find them. 
        Seems there's nothing else for it but to start the search! First, let's look for the music-loving Wilder.
        First stop, the Dark Forest!

506.Name: Babbling Brook
506.Description: Solise has always dwelled alone in the depths of the forest. Like most Wilders, she is peace-loving and content in her own corner of the realm. As a flower whisperer, she can communicate with plants and listen to their joys and sorrows. Nonetheless, the forest is not spared from the imminent threat being unleashed by the elemental imbalance. The chaotic elements are spreading and Solise is feeling the forest's pain from its whimpers. She cannot bear the forest's suffering, and decides to protect her home in her own way.

1032.Name: Art of Conquest
1032.Description: Everyone knows that the Empire's Imperial Military Barracks are well-known for turning average citizens into well-disciplined, resolute soldiers. The military established "Battle Trials" to test the knowledge that these soldiers carry, to determine whether or not they can use this knowledge to overcome their enemies. The Battle Trials encompasses many realistic challenges that soldiers may actually encounter while roaming Esperia. The adversaries within the trial aren't your average foes, they possess the power of the arcane, and there are many magically imbued War Relics to be found within the trial. The foes within the trial are abnormally strong, and in most cases cannot be fought head on. Only by using patience, opportunity and wit, can they be bested. With the proper utilization of War Relics, the weak can overcome the strong and clench victory from the jaws of defeat. This is the Art of Conquest.

303.Name: Descent of the White Wolf
303.Description: Due to a teleporting gone wrong, Geralt the Witcher and the sorceress Yennefer found themselves stranded in Esperia. With nothing to rely on but their sword and magic, they tried to find their way home. They must take great care as they navigate through the different forces at play in this wild, strange world. In a remote mountain village, the duo finally discovered a clue to their way back. But little did they know that a crisis involving the Graveborns and the Astral Academy was brewing…

296.Name: Limestone Valley
296.Description: To establish his business empire, Rowan - The Roamer travels and seeks out various magical treasures to explore unique market opportunities. Once, Rowan heard from a market vendor of a mysterious herb in the east that could resurrect the dead. However, Limestone Village, where the herbs grow, was surrounded by unscalable mountains. To this day, no one has been able to obtain such herbs and witness their amazing effects. To Rowan, with his keen business acumen, all this sounded like a great business opportunity. To seek these magical herbs and take his first step towards dominating the herbs trade, he invited his old friend, Lorsan - The Wind Whisperer, along on a quest to the remote, isolated village of Limestone…

1033.Name: The Hunting Trail
1033.Description:
In the howl of the biting frozen winds, the curtain never falls on the tale of the Wolf and the Sheep.
    Dueling Blasters at the ready, she marched on in the direction her demonic quarry had vanished. Exasperated by the snowfall concealing and confounding the beast's tracks, she cursed. A huge coffin gradually appeared behind her as Fawkes calmly analyzed their surroundings from beneath the brim of his hat, piecing together clues with his eagle eyes.
    Fawkes raised his crossbow and pointed North-west, a resolve in his eyes that Raine knew and trusted without reservation.
    With their capes fluttering in the gale winds, the Bounty Hunters pressed on in their pursuit.

507.Name: Frosty Plains
507.Description:
Rumor has it that during their migration, the dwarves buried their precious brew formula in the Frosty Plains. They hoped that one day fate would lead the right folks to discover the ice lotus, a special treasure the dwarves had left behind that contains directions to the legendary formula.
After hearing the story, Rigby Brown, founder and brewmaster of the Noble Tavern, immediately sets out to find the long-lost recipe. Of course, he will not forget to bring along a handy helper, having learned from his painful experience hunting for new formulas in recent years.
Will Rigby succeed in his quest? Follow the lead of the ice lotus and you shall find out.

703.Name: Prison's Past
703.Description:
The Black Prison is a dreadful place filled with torture and painful cries. It is where those souls who dare to challenge or disobey Thoran are condemned. When Thoran seized control of Bantus with his army of Graveborn, he had multiple Black Prisons built throughout the realm to torture any rebellious soul. After his regime was fortified, the prisons on the outskirts were slowly abandoned, leaving only the main one at the heart of the forsaken capital.
After escaping the Black Prison on the border of Bantus, Treznor - The Aggrieved never returned to this land which is filled with harrowing memories. Despite having settled on the Island of the Banished as a Tainted, he never forgot his past. Years later, he decided to return to the abandoned Black Prison to search for traces of his former comrades.

1034.Name: Price of Rebirth
1034.Description: Grezhul was assassinated in an attempt on Thoran's life, it was indeed a bloody coup. Verging on the precipice between life and death, a voice rings out, something about a 'soul deal'. Grezhul understood the price, but such was the depth of his desire for revenge that it was not too steep. His hand forced, he agrees to the disembodied voice's terms...

295.Name: Hopeless Isle
295.Description:
The Elemental Strife is spreading to all corners of the realm. Even the far-flung Island of the Banished cannot hope to escape from its devastation. Corruptors have occupied this once peaceful isle, while the Wood Guardian has exhausted all her energy trying to save the Tainted. She lies frail and feeble in her cage, waiting to be rescued.
Baden and the Wind Guardian have set sail and arrived at the island that is now crawling with the Corruptors. What awaits them is a fate unknown and fraught with unprecedented perils...

304.Name: The Painter's Spell
304.Description: In Esperia, there is no place that captivates Leonardo more than the Dark Forest. The magician-artist has set up a studio on the edge of the woods, where he has created countless exquisite and enchanted paintings. Today, Pippa smelled the magic of the artworks and, together with her friend Nemora, followed the scent to Leonardo's studio. Mesmerized by the magic, she could not resist touching one of the paintings, which triggered a powerful force that sucked both of them into it...

508.Name: The Forest's Trial
508.Description: Hearing Pippa talk about her life as a student at the Astral Academy piqued Raku's curiosity, particularly when she mentioned the "trials" where multiple students competed with one another. They sounded like a thrill to Raku, especially the part where the winner receives a medal or trophy engraved with their name. To help her friend out, Pippa reached out to Grandpa Ulmus to set up a trial for Raku. How will Raku fare?

1035.Name: Void Rift
1035.Description: A small town on the edges of the Lightbearer's dominion finds itself being slowly eroded by a mysterious dark force. The land is slowly being eaten away at, a foreboding sign of an impending invasion. Although once weakened, disciples of this dark force still roam the world, with their evil intentions forever unceasing. After years of laying in wait, the disciples have risen once more to create a nefarious pentagram that is able to bend and break the fabric of reality, ushering in a new malevolence in from the Void Realm. In order to uphold order within the realm, heroes must step into this distorted land which has been infected by the Void Realm. Only by repelling this infectious force that permeates this land, can order be reinstated.

704.Name: Purifying Flame
704.Description:
"Death's Denier" Raine is searching for a crafty, shapeshifting Hypogean. Tracking it down to the peaceful countryside village of Stillwater, she ends up partnering with Walker "The Lone Ranger" to hunt it down. Hunting dangerous Hypogeans is normally left to Guild experts, but Walker has no choice if he wants to get his hands on clues that might lead to his sworn enemy's location.
With their goals aligned, this deadly dynamic duo have formed a temporary alliance. Unfortunately, the crafty Hypogean they're up against is a cut above his monstrous companions, and aided by a dark secret hidden underneath the quiet village's surface...

1036.Name: Ice Isles
1036.Description:
The Ice Isles are situated to the North East of the ever-changing Jade Reef Bay, reaching it only takes a few hours by sea, although not many folk would want to visit the isles these days.
        However, the Ice Isles were not always known by the same name as they are today. These isles were once a major transit point of the maritime trade routes, but during a fierce arcane war of yesteryear, the elemental equilibrium of the isles was completely devastated, thus, ice and snow now prevails, covering the whole landscape.
        No longer is life capable of surviving in such extremes, what were once lush green fields and woods are now nothing more than a barren desert. Few people know of the sleeping volcano that lays hidden deep beneath the thick icy exterior of the island.
        Lately the volcano has been showing new signs of life, there are signs of fire again on the frigid Ice Isles.

4005.Name: Merchant's Adventures
4005.Description: The vast realm of Esperia has nurtured diverse produce and customs,. To the savvy Rowan, these spell great business opportunities. Recently, he heard of a wondrous city in a far-flung corner, with an exotic culture and unique local goods. It's a fantastic opportunity Rowan cannot pass up, and so he sets off for the place with great excitement and enthusiasm. However, little did he expect the wild encounters that lay ahead on his journey…

294.Name: Midwinter Wonderland
294.Description:
"Hidden deep within the howling blizzards of the snowcapped mountains, a mysterious amusement park appears during the Midwinter Festivities."
"There, you can find merry-go-rounds of all shapes and colors, parades of marching elves and flying fairies, and tables full of tasty treats."
This fanciful fairy tale has been passed down for generations in Esperia, and countless children have dreamed of seeing it for themselves.
So if you believe in the Midwinter Wonderland, then pack your sledges full of presents and prepare yourselves! For only those who pass the park's three trials can enter through its gate...

172.Name: Glorious Dawn
172.Description: Even the Temple of Light is struggling with the chaos and destruction wrought by the Elemental Strife. With the suffering of the people weighing heavy on her heart, Priestess of the Light Belinda has resolved to look beyond her order for help, and has embarked upon a dangerous and unfamiliar road...

1037.Name: Ancient Seal
1037.Description:
In those days of malevolence, three brave men - a swordsman, a mage and a craftsman - fought to defend their home. Employing their exceptional skill and wisdom, they crushed the demon's minions, pursuing them all the way to the cavern hideout, planning of destroying the demon that threatened their home. After the battle, the demon fell into a deep slumber, the exhausted warriors, unable to finish it off were left with no choice but to seal it away. In order to end the threat once and for all, the mage and craftsman transformed the cave where the demon rests and established a rigorous trial. They hoped that in the future, brave individuals of considerable talent and power would be able to totally eradicate the demon scourge.
Centuries later, the exploits of those three brave men have descended into rumor, a jumble of truth and fiction falling from the mouths of drunkards. Little do they know, the demon is about to stir...

510.Name: Gunning For Gold
510.Description: The road never ends for Rowan. The ambitious young merchant is aiming to become the wealthiest businessman of all time! Finding himself far from home, Rowan has seized the opportunity to take advantage of a newfound peace between the Lightbearer Empire and the Maulers! Come on, Rowan! Time to dispense with the moniker "Rowan the Second Son" one chest of gold at a time—starting with the first!

705.Name: Glacial Calamity
705.Description: Situated in the southern reaches of the empire, Glacier Town experiences heavy snow year round, making it a paradise for ice elementals. As Lorsan travels through the area, he makes a startling discovery: the town has been cut off from the outside world. He spies an imperial official's tent on the road leading to Glacier Town, and the Wind Whisperer's curiosity gets the better of him. Carefully, he lifts the flap and takes a peek inside...

293.Name: Cycle of Sorrow
293.Description: Legend has it that there is an ancient ruin buried deep underground, filled with marvelous treasures and equally nefarious traps. Just one wrong step will send you back to the start of this rumored "Cycle of Sorrow". Hearing of the riches within this abyss, experienced adventurers Vurk and Skreg have shown up at the entrance with Skreg's loyal Iron-jaw Savagehorn in tow.

1038.Name: Forgotten Ruins
1038.Description:
A sunken land, a fallen temple. The pure white Divine Light fades with each passing day. The beleaguered souls of the dead saw the light once more and surged towards it while they still had the chance. A small corner of the region reveals a place of great divinity that has since fallen into obscurity, and over time become forgotten.
        Emissaries of the Light have arrived in the area to seek out any traces of mankind's forgotten past.

305.Name: The Last Obsidian Finch
305.Description: The Elemental Strife intensifies, and a pall of gloomy haze envelops this land that has already been ravaged beyond recognition. Talene leads the inheritors of the Elemental Emblem to the Bastion of the Elements. They believe that by activating the Elemental Altar, they can bring balance to the elements and restore peace to Esperia. The heroes solemnly await the final battle, but little do they know that an unexpected crisis has long lurked within their ranks...

173.Name: The Great Escake
173.Description: Pippa and Raku are baking a cake to celebrate yet another year of fun adventures together. Unfortunately, the often-careless Pippa messed up a magical spell designed to make the cake irresistibly tasty. Before they realize what's going on, Pippa and Raku appear to have been transformed into residents of a realm of pure cake! Worse yet, Pippa has forgotten the enchantment to undo her spell! How will they ever escape this delicious mess?

4006.Name: Gourmelee
4006.Description: It's time again for Oakenfell's annual Glorious Celebration complete with fanfare and fireworks! The Lady of the City is also holding a special banquet in one of her favorite restaurants from the days of her youth with Rosaline's help. Rosaline may have to rescue a struggling restaurant and become one of the greatest chefs in Oakenfell's history to bring all of Hathor's greatest delicacies to the local dining table!

509.Name: The Encroaching Mist
509.Description: Ever-curious Peggy has embarked upon yet another solo adventure, and this time is rescued from Mabeast clutches by a half elf and her cat spirit. Peggy decides to repay her benefactors by helping to locate the source of Mabeast aggression—the mysterious Black Mist—en route to Oakenfell. Little does she know the deadly rift hidden deep within will soon plunge even tranquil Oakenfell into crisis...

291.Name: Cliff Realm
291.Description: Bard Angelo hasn't written a decent ballad for a long time. He began to look for new materials and came across a valley where puzzles of dwarfs were set. Angelo had a hard time navigating. Fortunately, his old dwarf pal Morvus agreed to accompany him into the valley to check the work of his clansmen...

513.Name: Blade Hunt
513.Description: Even the outermost villages of the Lightbearer Empire may prove attractive to Hypogean invaders, and the Temple of Light has received news of just such a destructive rampage. Cecilia and Lucius have been dispatched to deal with the menace and offer succor to refugees. Yet when the pair arrive with trepidation, they discover an even more powerful demon hunter already at work...

706.Name: Treasure of Time
706.Description: When Thali's hands start itching, the riff-raff of the desert had better start running! A group of human raiders sneak into Mauler's Enclave hoping to excavate the lost treasures of the dwarves, when they are unexpectedly caught by Thali. Thali calls on Kren to handle these greedy thieves, and the pair also discover that this ruin is filled with magical time-traveling altars, which transport their immediate surroundings back to their past state. Now, the true treasure lies somewhere in the gap between the past and the present.

290.Name: Swordsmanship
290.Description: Eironn's skill and dedication to the blade have already elevated him to the pinnacle of swordsmanship across the whole of Esperia. Yet Eironn still yearns for more. Intrigued by the prospect of witnessing Eironn's growth firsthand, Arden, the Nature's Voice has conceived of a trial intertwining Ice Elementals and the finesse of swordplay. So Eironn arrives at the frigid Tundra at the appointed hour, unaware of the surprise in store...

512.Name: Sage's Rite
512.Description: Pippa's done it again! Another day of practicing new spells in a busy forest has led to another disastrous magical accident which put everyone in danger. Time for an intervention! Gramp Arden has brought Pippa to a special section of the forest to teach her a thing or two about thinking before you cast. Pippa should be OK as long as she can handle some constructive feedback.

707.Name: Dunes of Darkness
707.Description: Safiya has been reborn from the Void, heralding the terrible destruction of her former allies—particularly the Arachin Queen, Ankhira. The Arachins have been driven by the Sphinxes into the distant desert under Ankhira's continuing queenship. But Safiya still is not satisfied with her former ally's plight, but has become all the more determined to extract ultimate vengeance on her quest for power. Yet it may be the most difficult impediment on Safiya's bloodsoaked quest may not be the enemy from without, but within.

514.Name: Twisted Tales
514.Description: Tasi browsed a peculiar fairy tale book and became the characters in the story! It's likely Tasi cannot escape the magic book until the story is over, and yet, the ending is different from what she expected. Fortunately, she can restart by returning to the first page...

1039.Name: The Final Night
1039.Description:
The final night of roaming the remote island is finally upon them. After days of fumbling for answers, the Heroes have finally found the key to eliminating the endless storm. The root of everything is the broiling heat deep within the volcano.
        Amidst growing suspicions and jealousies, the Heroes venture out to the Volcano, eliminating the source of it all and seeking a way to return home. Yet, lurking shadows are following not far behind, and with them the final encounter...
1039.UnlockTips: Compete 60% of the Forgotten Ruins adventure

601.Name: Snowpeak Swordsman
601.Description: Eironn the Stormsword came across an ancient ballad through his study of Dark Forest legends depicting a ruthless, near-invincible sword master, whose blade reigns frost and wind, atop a snow mountain and has decided to investigate. He is soon joined by Alaro the Desert's Eye, who comes on the same perilous journey out of his own inscrutable reasons.

289.Name: The Abyssal Range
289.Description: War veteran Morvus relishes the chance to lead another batch of the Royal Dwarven Marksmen recruits through another rigorous day at the royal range in hopes of building a fighting force strong enough to reconquer their lost lands. That is, until a Hypogean incursion into the range sets alarm bells ringing in the Royal Guard and lays fresh wounds into Morvus' seething hatred. Morvus and Captain Ginneas of the Moltenflow Regiment have arrived at the range—with plenty of muskets, gunpowder, and ill will.

1040.Name: Lost in the Wild
1040.Description:
Zzz...
Fwoooo - the soft wind pirouettes through the leaves.
Rustling in the depths of the forest shade, beneath a large fallen tree, illuminated by rays of sunlight,
there are two small furry creatures, their heads close together as if whispering secrets.

306.Name: Peculiar Flowers
306.Description: "I hear that your goldflares can produce a miraculous restorative medicine that has made you extremely rich." The detective inquired but was only greeted with one of Lady Lina's enigmatic smiles as she sipped her tea. Years passed, and an urgent missive arrived from Lady Lina's daughter, Miss Lotti, asking the detective for aid in her mother's disappearance. And so, Detective returns to Goldflare Manor, where veiled mysteries lie in wait.

1041.Name: The Sealing Sword
1041.Description: From a remote corner of the land, a long-forgotten town sends a plea for help, claiming that nearby Hypogeans are stirring, about to break through the town's defenses. The Lightbearer Empire intends to send troops to suppress the scourge, but the rugged mountain roads are hindering the army's advance. In desperation, the Empire issued a commission to bounty hunters, calling for heroes to wipeout the Hypogeans and save the town from ruin. The long-neglected town welcomed new visitors. Stepping into the town, they realized that the situation here is far more complex than the request for help had implied...

602.Name: The Lost Star
602.Description: The disaster brought by the Void Fragment had subsided at last. However, the peaceful days were short-lived, before a new crisis descended on the Dark Forest once again. Desiring to conquer the enchanted woods, a Hypogean thirsted for the power of the stars, laying a trap to capture and seal the force. As a result, Lyca's deer lost its celestial power overnight, and she in turn embarked on a journey to track down this Hypogean.

288.Name: Raid the Thieves Lair
288.Description: Bringing the Immortal to justice has long been the dream of Jerome and the Thousand Sail Fleet. When the Torchbearer finally blockaded the Pirates' secret refuge, a misfired cannonball suddenly blew both Jerome and Hodgkin into the pirates' lair. Although this ancient hidden cave is the ruthless pirates' home ground, Jerome remains fearless despite being alone and vows to arrest Hodgkin...

1042.Name: Gold Rush
1042.Description:
The Pioneer Route is a necessary path for businessmen to reach the Paradise of Wealth.
  This route is constantly traveled by merchants, but recently, a mysterious little thief has appeared here. His nostrils flaring, constantly sniffing, eager for every glittering treasures, his sticky little fingers will do whatever it takes to hold on to that alluring gold...
1042.UnlockTips: More than 60% progress toward "The Sealing Sword"

603.Name: Manor Mystery
603.Description: Lord Beckett contacted Robin Hood long ago, offering a huge reward to help deal with the bandits that had been harassing his manor. However, when Robin Hood finally set foot on this land, he did not come for the money, but to solve the mystery of the missing child...

287.Name: Daimon's Gift
287.Description: The Noctis Animarum Festival is just around the corner and Daimon was looking forward to celebrating it with his mother. They even prepared a magical juice machine in advance, but Shemira insists on leaving for a few days... The sulky Daimon has no choice but to prepare the juice all on his own, so that everything is ready when his mom returns. Will he succeed? And more importantly, will his mother like it?

909.Name: The Frozen Pass
909.Description: Snow falls while the wind works to slice its way through the bones of any wanderers who have chosen to traverse this treacherous terrain. The winding path works its way up and down the mountain sides, giving no chance for respite. The end of the year is upon us, and for some, the road home is a challenging one. If the way home passes through here, it would be a long and arduous journey. It was here, years ago, that Rowan met with countless trials and tribulations on his first trip home from his travels…

604.Name: Chord of Fate
604.Description:
The Oakenfell Music Festival has finally ended, but the musicians who finished performing have gone missing one after another, with only the lead singer untouched. After much investigation, the lead singer finally found clues to his teammates' whereabouts, and it all ties back to a forgotten music academy...

Stepping into the city's shadows, the lead singer comes to the Hypogean-ruled academy alone. Awaiting him within, other than the Hypogean lurking in the darkness, are eerie musical puzzles...

4011.Name: Dreamy Wonderland
4011.Description: A biting chill sweeps from the mountains as Esperia gets ready for another year of the Midwinter Festival. Estrilda has invited her uncle Baden, now a Graveborn, to join her in celebrating the most important holiday of the year. Together with Thane, they've chosen the old Rayne family manor on the outskirts of the city as the perfect venue. But just as they're about to welcome Baden into the manor, a strange rustling sound comes from the bushes near the gate...

4012.Name: Office Overhaul
4012.Description: Esperia is home to countless heroes, but beyond the limelight, powerful monster-run corporations lurk in the shadows. Its tireless creatures design elaborate dream realms, ensuring that an endless stream of heroes always has a fresh set of trials to overcome. It's been years since the Dreaf first joined Infernal Enterprises as an entry-level employee. But despite his tenure, he remains stuck at the absolute bottom, toiling away day after day under the cruel exploitation of his superiors. His youthful dreams have long been crushed by the daily grind, leaving the brief moments after work as his only escape. He had already resigned himself to this fate, ready to numb his way through the rest of his miserable career... until one fateful night, when a late-night message from management jolted him awake.

610.Name: Corporate Crucible
610.Description: Back in the day, a little Dreaf had just graduated. Young and full of dreams, it eagerly set out to apply for a position at the prestigious Infernal Enterprises, hoping to become a monster that could truly "change the world." But during the interview process, the Dreaf's confidence was shattered by a series of bizarre and ridiculous "trials," leaving the Dreaf questioning if it had come to the right place. Was this prestigious position really worth sacrificing its youth and passion?

523.Name: Delicious in Esperia
523.Description: The unrest caused by monsters has engulfed Esperia, tearing open a temporal rift that stretches all the way to a distant dungeon. Turbulence sweeps Laios, Marcille, Senshi, and Chilchuck away and brings them to the world of Esperia. Before they can make sense of their situation, a rich, mouthwatering aroma of cooking fills the air. With their stomachs rumbling, they instinctively follow the irresistible scent, embarking on a quest for the legendary "Delicious in Esperia"...

524.Name: Solo Leveling
524.Description: What seemed like a routine exploration for Sung Jinwoo took an unexpected turn when he found himself trapped inside a strange dungeon deep within Esperia. Now, the system has assigned him a special mission: complete it, or remain imprisoned here forever. As he pushes deeper into the dungeon, he encounters unfamiliar races, unknown warriors... and a slumbering Demon King, waiting to be awakened.

4013.Name: A Shared Hunt
4013.Description: At the height of summer, with the blistering sun high above, cheerful songs waft in on the sea breeze. As Esperia's annual summer feast is about to begin, crowds gather along the coast to sing the praises of the summer gods. This year, you and Alvida are in charge of the main dishes for the grand feast. While you're both still debating what to serve, a thunderous roar echoes from the depths of the ocean—a massive sea monster bursts through the waves! Excited, you quickly rally your companions and set sail for a nearby island, close to where the creature appeared. But in all the excitement, you somehow forgot the most important thing... preparing your hunting supplies!

526.Name: Out of Nowhere! "Heroes" Appear?
526.Description:
In a shadowy corner of Esperia, there lurks a band of zealous labyrinth designers. Obsessed with tricks and traps, they spend their lives crafting elaborate labyrinths meant to stop adventurers in their tracks. They call these creations "Wonders."
Though their mazes caused plenty of trouble, adventurers always found a way through. So the designers poured every ounce of their genius into building a labyrinth that was impossible to escape. To be safe, they even turned to forbidden rites, hoping to call forth mighty Hypogeans to guard the maze. But something went wrong. Instead of Hypogeans, two uninvited guests appeared...
